## Checklist

- [ ] The branch is named `feature/…`, `fix/…`, `docs/…`, `refactor/…` or `chore/…`
- [ ] `dotnet build` has no errors and `dotnet test` passes
- [ ] New visible texts are in Spanish (neutral Spanish, *tuteo*)
- [ ] It follows `docs/ARQUITECTURA.md` (git only through `IGitRunner`) and `docs/DISENO.md`
- [ ] Anything that can lose work asks for confirmation first
- [ ] New parsers or pure logic have tests; new git flows have an integration test
- [ ] I agree to the [license of contributions](../CONTRIBUTING.md#license-of-contributions): GPL-3.0-or-later, plus the right for the author to relicense it
